known_limitations: No metric in this release carries a value. Every PSA host, www.onetcenter.org and openrouter.ai returned HTTP 403 at this build environment's egress proxy, so no source could be retrieved. See data/sources/retrieval-manifest.json for the dated attempts.

The PSOC 2012 code list was entered from classification documentation rather than the PSA volume. Every classification row is marked unverified_pending_source and must be diffed against the PSA volume.

The canonical table holds PSOC major and sub-major groups only. Minor and unit groups are absent rather than guessed, so occupation-level metrics (wages, O*NET Job Zone, task exposure) have no unit to attach to yet.
No generative-AI task exposure score is published. The scoring harness requires task evidence that could not be retrieved and a provider that could not be reached.
The v1 exposure scores are not carried forward and are not a fallback.
This experimental exposure score has not yet undergone independent labour-economist validation.
No component of this release has been reviewed by a Philippine labour statistician.
